        StringBuilder temp = new StringBuilder();
        temp.append(s.charAt(0));
        int len = s.length();
        int idx = 1;
        while (idx < len) {
            if (idx + 2 < len && s.charAt(idx) == 'd' && s.charAt(idx + 1) == 'o' && s.charAt(idx + 2) == 't') {
                temp.append('.');
                idx += 3;
            } else {
                temp.append(s.charAt(idx));
                idx++;
            }
        }
        StringBuilder output = new StringBuilder();
        output.append(temp.charAt(0));
        boolean replacedAt = false;
        int j = 1;
        while (j < temp.length()) {
            if (!replacedAt && j + 1 < temp.length() && temp.charAt(j) == 'a' && temp.charAt(j + 1) == 't') {
                output.append('@');
                j += 2;
                replacedAt = true;
            } else {
                output.append(temp.charAt(j));
                j++;
            }
        }
        System.out.print(output.toString());
        sc.close();
    }
}
